build_DETR_model: build a DETR object detection model with a backbone, transformer, and configurable number of queries
run_DETR_forward: run the DETR model forward pass on a batched NestedTensor to get predicted logits and boxes
create_SetCriterion: create a SetCriterion loss module using Hungarian matching to supervise class labels and bounding boxes
run_PostProcess: run the PostProcess module to convert raw model outputs into COCO API format with scores and boxes
build_DETR_pipeline: build a complete DETR training pipeline with model, criterion, and postprocessors via the build function
